ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Scope of Minnesota Welfare Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the scope of welfare fraud in Minnesota, including the recent claims linking Somalia president Mohamud to the fraud.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and investigate the connections between high-profile individuals and the fraud.
questions: What is the scope of welfare fraud in Minnesota?
How are high-profile individuals connected to the fraud?
ideas.insight: The connection between Somalia president Mohamud and Minnesota welfare fraud funds is suspicious and warrants further investigation. Following the money and investigating the connections between high-profile individuals and the fraud could uncover a larger scheme.
